On VTES-L, GymNat1 <Gym...@AOL.COM> wrote:
> Kindred Segregation or Restructure....I can't remember says to choose a new
> seating order. Do the people take their cards with them? I went to a con and
> a guy used it and I ended up playing his deck. Fun, but is this the way it is
> played?

Kindred Restructure.

Since it says nothing about changing libraries or exchanging controlled
cards, etc., none of these things change - you continue to play with
your own library, crypt, ash heap, hand, uncontrolled, and controlled
regions. It is usually easier to move the cards around to reflect this,
("take your cards with you"), but however you want to keep track of
things is fine.
